title.narrative: Provision of Health, Nutrition, WASH, and Protection services

description.narrative: Under this SDN JR, IRC will carry out Health, WASH, Nutrition and Protection services in White Nile state (Kosti and Rabak localities). IRC will collaborate with 2 local partners, Al-Manar Voluntary Organization (AMVO) to conduct protection activities and CAFA to be involved in the other sectors.And, with the objective of addressing new displacements, IRC will extend its efforts to target Jazirah State and White Nile with MPCA under the Crisis modifier within this SDN JR.
